تنتقعي (form VIII)
# تَنْتَقِعِي (tantaqiʕī) /tan.ta.qi.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
# تُنْتَقَعِي (tuntaqaʕī) /tun.ta.qa.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
